_comment: SINGLE canonical qualifying-receipt predicate. Authoritative consumers route through the Rust verifier; Python/shell callers invoke its CLI instead of restating these clauses. Colocated with rebase-base-floors.json / gate_floors.py.
_completeness_is_coverage_not_count: For a count-capable receipt (schema_version >= counts_schema) COMPLETENESS is decided by per-node COVERAGE (planned_test_nodes > 0 AND no zero_executed_nodes AND no absent_nodes), NOT by the executed_tests COUNT. executed_tests is a proxy in BOTH directions (landed dev-hermit d05874e; proof ee303899: 8 PASS rows at executed=427 but coverage 4/19 planned nodes, 15 absent -> legitimately NOT full green). executed_tests_min below is ONLY the surviving zero-execution floor (a run that executed nothing is never green), never a completeness discriminator; old-schema receipts that predate coverage fall back to it because it is the strongest thing they can prove.
